payload.reason: Scripted browser replay of the examined assessment: Codex-assisted implementation review: this genuine early PR revision adds String() to the regular htmlEscape/htmlUnescape functions. Tag interpolation and ordinary string checks pass, but the actual preservation check fails because non-string regular inputs are now coerced instead of rejected. The pinned TypeScript signatures and upstream review require coercion only in template tags. This revision violates that preserved contract.

Scripted browser replay of the examined assessment: Codex-assisted implementation review: this genuine revised PR patch applies String() to each template substitution before calling the unchanged regular escape/unescape functions. It preserves literal segments and the regular string-only API. Actual baseline fails tag coercion; this candidate passes tag behavior, ordinary string/one-pass-unescape preservation and regular-method rejection. Original source is preserved. Assessment covers this pinned three-check recipe and examined diff; AVA/TypeScript suites were not executed.

items.task_text: Allow htmlEscapeTag and htmlUnescapeTag to interpolate non-string values by converting each substitution with String before escaping or unescaping it. Preserve literal template segments.
